At intake/new-business review, before the case advances to issue; screening uses the replacement forms and application answers submitted with the case.

The replacement question on the application is answered, and where 'yes' a signed replacement notice and 1035 paperwork (existing carrier, policy number, values) are present; a 'yes' answer with no notice is flagged as incomplete.
Count of cases with a replacement indicator (application answer, 1035 form or notice) equals count flagged as replacements in the PAS; the two reconcile with 0 missed flags.
Replacement/1035 documents are imaged to OpenText under /suitability/<policy-no>/ and the replacement flag is set on the PAS case with a timestamp; retained per policy.
Applications indicating replacement but missing the notice/1035 paperwork are held as exceptions and the documents requested from the producer before the case proceeds.
Monthly population of new life/annuity applications processed, with a quarterly 25-file review focus.
PASS = every application with a replacement indicator is flagged and has the required 1035/notice documentation; FAIL = any replacement missed at intake or flagged without the required forms.
Missed replacements or missing forms are corrected at review, the case re-flagged, and repeat producer omissions referred to compliance; exceptions logged in the GRC platform.
Acceptance criteria: all replacement activity is detected at intake and each replacement case carries the signed notice and 1035 documentation before advancing.
Evidence is the replacement flag on the PAS case plus imaged 1035/replacement notices under /suitability/<policy-no>/.
